slides.text: habits of friends who never make you feel late
sending a blurry photo of a street sign with no caption, just because it was your running joke at sixteen.
answering an out-of-the-blue text like you only stepped out of the room for a glass of water.
stopping to talk to your mum in the cereal aisle for ten minutes without mentioning how long it has been.
picking up the phone on a tuesday night without once asking [[where have you been]].
mailing a birthday card every august, even if it still goes to your parents' old address.
sliding into a diner booth across from you and picking up a sentence from three years ago.
save this for the friend who never asks for an apology when life gets quiet.

caption:
we get busy with work, rent and tired evenings, but an old friend never counts the quiet months against you.
save this for a slow sunday when you finally dial their number.

#childhoodfriends #longdistancefriendship #friendshipquotes
alt: A carousel post about the comforting habits of old friends who never make you feel guilty for drifting apart.
